question: Can the planner use the gap between fitting and held-group scores to invent new regularization values for the actual leading pipeline rather than run only hand-specified encoder heads?
mechanism: Only a completed competitive primary trial with an executable scalar C can generate alternatives. Multiply and divide its C by exp(clip(6 times the positive training gap, log(1.7), log(8))), within [0.001, 64]. Register the exact template and generated value by digest. These are options and need not be selected. This rule consumes no external feedback and knows no model, dataset name or feature columns.
